craft_evidence.owned: Evidence (NB 2025 Sustainability and Impact Report pp.4-8; 18 Sep 2026 and 19 Feb 2026 NB releases): NB owns five athletic-footwear factories in New England - Lawrence and Methuen MA; Norway ME; Central Maine (Skowhegan) ME; Londonderry NH - and one in Flimby, UK; about 1,100 associates in New Engla
craft_evidence.makers: None on product pages (0 of 37 apparel PDPs and 0 of 2 footwear PDPs read name a factory or maker).
craft_evidence.mills: None on product pages. Horween leather is named in NB's own Made in USA FW26 release (U992BB), not on a product page.

craft_evidence.process: Claim-level only. Product pages name materials and foams (pigskin suede overlays, ENCAP, FuelCell) and the rule that Made in USA footwear has a domestic value of 70% or more. No making process is desc
craft_evidence.reasoning: NB documents its own making: five owned footwear factories in New England (Lawrence, Methuen, Norway, Skowhegan, Londonderry) and Flimby in the UK, in its 2025 report and press boilerplate. That making covers only Made in USA/UK footwear, which NB itself calls "a limited portion" of US sales. Of 37 apparel pages read, 34 say only "Imported" and name no maker or mill, so this is a 4 for real owned making that does not cover the range (a 3 is arguable on share).
